title: Transverse wave
content: If the displacements of particles of the medium are perpendicular to the direction of the wave, such a wave is called a transverse wave.
e: If the displacements of particles of the medium are perpendicular to the direction of the wave, such a wave is called a transverse wave. Transverse wave is a travelling disturbance that carries energy, not the medium itself. In a transverse wave the particles shake at right angles to the travel.

title: Longitudinal wave
content: If the displacements of particles of medium are parallel to the direction of the waves, such a wave is called a longitudinal wave.
e: If the displacements of particles of medium are parallel to the direction of the waves, such a wave is called a longitudinal wave. Longitudinal wave is a travelling disturbance that carries energy, not the medium itself. In a longitudinal wave the particles shake along the travel, as in sound.

title: Wavelength
content: The distance between any two consecutive wave crests (or) two consecutive wave troughs is called wavelength.
e: The distance between any two consecutive wave crests (or) two consecutive wave troughs is called wavelength. Wavelength is the distance from one crest to the next crest. Wavelength is crest to next crest, and v equals f lambda.

title: Frequency
content: The number of complete waves passing a point per second is called frequency of waves.
e: The number of complete waves passing a point per second is called frequency of waves. Frequency is how many complete waves pass a point each second. Frequency counts complete waves per second, and v equals f lambda.

title: Period
content: The time taken by the wave to travel the distance between any two consecutive wave crests (or) the time required for one complete vibration is called period of a wave.
e: The time taken by the wave to travel the distance between any two consecutive wave crests (or) the time required for one complete vibration is called period of a wave. Period is the time for one complete vibration.

title: Amplitude
content: The amplitude of a wave is the maximum value of displacement of vibrating element.
e: The amplitude of a wave is the maximum value of displacement of vibrating element. Amplitude is the maximum displacement of the vibrating particle. Displacement can be smaller than the path if the path bends.

title: Wavefront
content: The surface that joins all the points of same phase is called wavefront.
e: The surface that joins all the points of same phase is called wavefront. Wavefront is measured or named exactly that way in this chapter.
